data.one_liner: Create clickable HTML-style image map areas with customizable colors on images.
data.what_it_does: Implements the HTML image map standard in Flutter, allowing developers to define hot areas on images using coordinates. Users can tap or click these interactive regions to trigger responses.
use_when: You need to make specific regions of an image interactive like an HTML image map.
You want to render clickable polygons or areas over an image.
avoid_when: You only need standard image loading without interactive regions.
You need complex vector graphics manipulation not based on coordinate mapping.
strengths: Implements standard HTML image map behavior in Flutter.
Compatible with output from common image map tools like image-map.net.
weaknesses: Limited feature set focused solely on image mapping.
Relies on external tools or coordinate definitions to build regions.
